{{Attr|Freeze}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Devious Slash}}''' – '''Hex's Maw''' swings two times with its sword in an obtuse arc, stunning towers for 3.5 seconds and dealing 150 damage to units. |ability1_cooldown = 10 }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hex's Maw''' was the third boss that appeared in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had the [[Stun Immunity]], making it immune to knockback and stuns, being only slowed down by stuns. When it first appeared, it was a [[Boss]] enemy, granting multiple immunities. It also occasionally spawned as a [[Bloated]], [[Nimble]] or [[Freeze Immunity|Freeze Immune]] enemy. It had an ability, ''Devious Slash,'' where it swung in a wide arc with its sword, stunning towers for 3.5 seconds and dealing 150 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Hex's Maw''' had light maroon skin. It wore a brown shirt, pants and cape. It also wore red shoes, grey spiked shoulder-pads, chestplate, padding around its waist and elbow-pads. On its head, it had a grey metal mask with long horns, which resembled a skull. It held a large grey sword with its blade split in half, only slightly connected in certain spots. ==Strategy== *As the '''Hex's Maw''' appears on Wave 16, high DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Gatling Gun]], [[Engineer]] and [[Minigunner]] are recommended. **Support towers such as the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at providing boosts to your towers. ***The [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give such towers hidden detections. *The '''Hex's Maw''' has quite high defense. Because of this, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[Freezer]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be useful against it. *Because of its immunities, it cannot be knocked back, frozen or chilled, and it is only slowed down instead of being stunned by stunning towers. **Additionally, when it first spawns it is a [[Boss]] enemy, making it immune to even more forms of stalling. The only towers capable of slowing it down as a [[Boss]] are stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Trapper]]. ==Trivia== *The '''Hex's Maw''' used the same animations as the [[Fallen Guardian]], and shared the basic functionality of its ability with it. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Hex's Maw''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Hex's Maw's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex's Maw''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Hex's Maw''' can no longer have its defense dropped while a [[Boss]] enemy. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex’s Maw''' removed. ==Notes== {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Nightmarish Hulk]]|Wave 13|Hex's Maw|Wave 16|[[Conserver]]|Wave 20}} {{Containment|[[Hex Weaver]]|Wave 22|Hex's Maw|Wave 23|[[Corrupted Conserver (Hexscape)|Corrupted Conserver]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
